methodology: Sequence is derived from: (1) prerequisite dependencies between topics (a topic that is a foundation for others is scheduled before them, even if its own PYQ count is lower), (2) priority tier (P1 before P2 before P3/P4) within each dependency group, (3) source PYQ frequency as tiebreaker. This is a preparation-order recommendation, not an official GATE ordering.
note: Only P1/P2 topics are sequenced explicitly below (144 topics). P3/P4 topics are revision-tier and can be slotted in after their subject's P1/P2 topics are done, or left for final revision passes.
